newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Devex says seeks new coal partner.
newsitem.headline: Devex says seeks new coal partner.

text.p: Australian miner Devex Ltd said on Wednesday it has told Cyprus/Oakbridge, the operator of its Bellbird coal mine, that it will seek a new partner to develop the 160 million tonne resource.
Devex managing director Harry Adams, said talks had begun with several parties, both coal companies and mining contractors, to operate and fund the development of the mine.
Devex was disappointed at the pace of development at the mine, which is adjacent to Cyprus/Oakbridge's Ellalong colliery, Adams said.
Bellbird, which lies in New South Wales' Hunter Valley, produces about a million tonnes of soft coking coal a year.
Adams said Devex was also considering the sale of the mine to a future operator. Bellbird has a book value of A$20 million.
Oakbridge Pty Ltd is 42 percent owned by the U.S. Cyprus Amax mining group, the second largest coal producer in the United States.
